description: This file provides help content and UI for the SuiteCRM installation process, including help steps and menu HTML generation.

classes.name: HelpItem
classes.description: A class representing a help item with associated field, title, and text.

methods.name: help_menu_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for the main help menu with links to each help step.

methods.name: format_help_items
methods.description: Formats an array of HelpItem objects into an HTML table.

methods.name: help_step_1_html
methods.description: Generates HTML content for the first help step, covering prerequisites.

methods.name: help_step_2_html
methods.description: Generates HTML content for the second help step, covering database configuration.

methods.name: help_step_3_html
methods.description: Generates HTML content for the third help step, covering site configuration.

methods.name: help_step_4_html
methods.description: Generates HTML content for the fourth help step, performing installation.

methods.name: help_step_5_html
methods.description: Generates HTML content for the fifth help step, registration.
